description:
dotnet new template for BrixCMS — a free, open-source, block-based CMS for ASP.NET Core 10.

✅ 45+ drag-and-drop content blocks (Hero, Gallery, FAQ, Cards, Map, Video, QR, Countdown…)
✅ AI chatbot — local Ollama (free, private) or Gemini cloud (free tier, BYOK)
✅ PDF semantic search with vector embeddings
✅ Headless REST API — serve content to Next.js, Nuxt, React, Vue or Flutter
✅ Visual page editor — no code required
✅ Multi-admin with role-based permissions
✅ SQLite (zero-config) · SQL Server · PostgreSQL
✅ Newsletter, Cookie banner, XML Sitemap, SEO meta
✅ AES-256-GCM key encryption · TOTP 2FA · PBKDF2 passwords
✅ MIT license — free to use, modify, distribute

Install template:
  dotnet new install BrixCMS.Open.Templates

Create a new site:
  dotnet new brixcms -n MyWebsite
  cd MyWebsite
  dotnet run

Also available in Visual Studio 2022: New Project → search "BrixCMS".

Docs: https://github.com/Learsi23/BrixCMS
Pro: https://brixc-ms.com
releaseNotes: v1.2.0 — Gemini cloud AI support (free tier BYOK), full Headless REST API with nested block tree, 45+ blocks, PDF upload via admin panel, improved security headers.
title: BrixCMS Open — .NET 10 CMS Template (Blazor, Headless, AI)
